name: ImGuiWindow.CollapsingHeader
description: Appends a collapsing header start marker, immediately calls the content callback with the same ImGuiWindow object so it can append nested elements, then appends a header end marker. Nested elements are skipped while the header is collapsed. Callback errors are caught.

parameters.name: content
parameters.description: Callback receiving the same ImGuiWindow object so nested controls can be appended.
